x-lid.version_rule: MINOR: additive; no existing schema or entity file is changed
changes_from_as_received: cycle status enum is TRACED / PROPOSED / UNKNOWN; PROPOSED_UNSOURCED retired; fields unsourced and legacy_status added
traces v0.1 and v0.2 carry the retired status and validate against the as-received schema, not this copy
0.2.0: cycle field phases added (ordered list, optional)
0.3.0: optional status_history on nodes and cycles (list of {version, status, date?, note?}); the v0.3 trace's status_history is now accepted

title: reference trace file
description: One known-answer dependency trace for one attribute of one entity (e.g. reference/reference_trace_BE_hex_v0.2.json). Layers run D0_law (governing law) to D5_pattern (the recorded attribute). Cross-field and cross-item invariants that JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express are enforced by reference/trace_check.py and documented on the fields they govern: dangling depends_on targets, paths from the D5 root to D0, cycle parent existence, and the nesting invariant parent.period_s > child.period_s. Style follows schemas/provenance_step.schema.json: closed objects, explicit required lists, hash strings as full lowercase sha256 hex.

node_status.description: Trace vocabulary. TRACED: sourced to a named work. DERIVED: computed from TRACED inputs. CONTESTED: sources disagree; all accounts are kept. PROPOSED / RECORDED_UNVERIFIED / UNKNOWN carry no confidence. TRACED, DERIVED and CONTESTED require a non-empty source list (enforced below by if/then). NOTE: cycles use a different status vocabulary (see the cycle definition); unifying the two vocabularies is open work.

deviation.description: Deviation within scope. String form is the current prose form (e.g. '±0.01 (prose in measurement_limits)'). Object form is the structured upgrade proposed in the translation-loss ledger (L05 + GUM map): {value, kind, asymmetric?}. See translation_loss_blocks.schema.json for the full confidence record this field upgrades into.

cycle.description: One named cycle. Byte-identical to definitions.cycle in cycle_registry.schema.json; the validation suite asserts the two definitions stay equal so they cannot drift silently. Nesting invariant: when both parent and child carry period_s, parent.period_s / child.period_s must be > 1 (trace_check.py NESTING_VIOLATION); the log10 of that ratio is the timescale-separation ladder. Expressible only per-pair, so it is checker-enforced, not schema-enforced. Adopted copy: status vocabulary shared with nodes; unsourced is a flag.

name.description: Every cycle is named (owner rule, ledger v0.3): sleep, circadian, seasonal, compute. A bare word 'cycle' is not a name.

kind.description: keeps oscillation, developmental window, production cycle and a transient inside a cycle apart without ranking them. Extending this enum is backward compatible; removing a value is not.

period_s.description: Period in seconds. Null or absent when unsourced (trace_check.py CYCLE_NO_PERIOD is informational, not an error).

period_text.description: The period as recorded, with uncertainty and sample size where known (e.g. '≈230 Hz (229.8 ± 11.0 Hz, n=4, hovering)').

context.description: The conditions the period holds under: a cycle is a cycle of whatever is in context.

parent.description: Id of the enclosing slower cycle, or null/absent at the top of the nesting. Must name an existing cycle (trace_check.py CYCLE_DANGLING_PARENT).

source.description: Source strings or URLs. Null marks an explicitly unsourced cycle (observed on PROPOSED_UNSOURCED); when present the list is non-empty. TRACED requires a non-empty list (if/then below; trace_check.py CYCLE_NO_SOURCE).

status.description: One vocabulary shared with nodes. PROPOSED_UNSOURCED is retired (registry/DECLARED.json, amendment 'process form + Kimi schemas'): it is written PROPOSED with unsourced true. TRACED requires source.

unsourced.description: True when no source describes the item. Only with status PROPOSED. Replaces the retired status PROPOSED_UNSOURCED.

legacy_status.description: The status as first recorded, when it was mapped (for example PROPOSED_UNSOURCED).

phases.description: The cycle's phases in order, earliest first. Optional. Used to decide whether a phase is completed relative to phase_now. For a repeating cycle the order reads one turn.

status_history.description: Earlier statuses, oldest first. A status change is recorded here; the earlier status is never overwritten out of the record.

version.description: Record version, e.g. '0.2'. Prior versions stay on disk unchanged (append-only convention).

status.description: Document lifecycle. PROPOSED: under review. TRACED: accepted as a known-answer reference. SUPERSEDED: replaced by a newer version; the supersedes_note of the successor names this file.

baseline_commit.description: Git commit hash of the repository baseline the trace was built against (v0.2: 63d93c00951b14ed7352891747468c9b65cca146). 40 hex chars for a SHA-1 commit, 64 if the repository moves to SHA-256. Not to be confused with the sha256 step and source ids, which are always 64 hex.

entity.description: Entity id in the repository, e.g. BE.

attribute.description: Attribute name on that entity, e.g. hexagonal_cell_efficiency.

rule.description: The one-line reading rule the trace was built under, kept verbatim.

supersedes_note.description: Names the prior version this record replaces (PROV-O wasRevisionOf). The prior file stays unchanged beside this one.

claim.description: What the node asserts, in prose. Where the node carries a repo value, the claim quotes it verbatim.

y.description: Best estimate. Number, string or list as recorded; never coerced.

regime.description: Regime the value holds under, when stated inline.

source.description: Source strings or URLs. Required when status is TRACED, DERIVED or CONTESTED (if/then below; trace_check.py NO_SOURCE).

note.description: Free note. Notes containing '*_MISMATCH' or 'GAP' are surfaced by trace_check.py as NOTED_MISMATCH / GAP findings; the words are load-bearing.

depends_on.description: Ids of nodes this node depends on. Every id must exist in nodes (trace_check.py DANGLING_DEP). Untyped strings today; the typed dependency record {target, layer, role, required_in_regime, equation_ref, status, source} proposed in the ledger is the v0.3 upgrade path.

repo_entity.description: Repository entity this node corresponds to, when one exists.

regime.description: Free-form regime descriptor (bounds, variable lists, outside-scope rule). Shapes vary by node; closed sub-schemas come with the regime block proposal (ledger L03).

links_repo.description: Repo attribute or candidate entities this node binds to, as prose.

unsourced.description: True when no source describes the node. Only with status PROPOSED.

status_history.description: Earlier statuses, oldest first. A status change is recorded here; the earlier status is never overwritten out of the record.

cycles.description: The named cycles the trace touches, fastest to slowest. The standalone registry form of this array validates against cycle_registry.schema.json.

environment_differential.description: v0.2 section: one question, two or more named regimes, and what is invariant, variant, or unknown between them.

regimes.description: Regime names (e.g. MANUKA, WILDFLOWER). Every variant_nodes entry must carry a key for each regime; trace_check.py enforces (DIFF_REGIME_MISSING). Schema-side, regime columns are string-valued additional properties on the variant node.

invariant_nodes.description: node id -> why it does not depend on the regime. Keys must exist in nodes (trace_check.py DIFF_UNKNOWN_NODE).

unknown_dependence.description: node id -> what is not known about its regime dependence. Keys must exist in nodes.

node.description: Node id, or a named quantity not (yet) a node.

status.description: TRACED: all regime columns sourced. PARTIAL: some regimes sourced, others open.

additionalProperties.description: Regime columns: one key per entry in regimes, value the quantity or observation under that regime.

sign.description: Signed direction within scope: '+', '-', or an explicit non-sign statement (e.g. 'GENOTYPE-DEPENDENT', 'NONE (variance share, not a direction)'). A local sign is not a global importance ranking; scope is mandatory so the sign cannot be read out of regime.

magnitude.description: Magnitude as recorded, with the study's own numbers.

scope.description: Conditions the sign and magnitude hold under. A sensitivity without scope is rejected (trace_check.py SENSITIVITY_INCOMPLETE).

cycle_link.description: Id of the cycle this sensitivity runs on, when known.

classification.description: Why the two claims do or do not contradict once each is read inside its own scope. Both are kept; neither is smoothed over.

classification_scheme.description: Named category boundaries for the differential (e.g. DHA:Tsugar low/moderate/high), with source and note as string values.

repo_bindings.description: v0.2 section: binds repository dependency strings (scope.dependencies on the entity attribute) to trace nodes and cycles. Targets must exist in nodes or cycles (trace_check.py BINDING_TARGET_MISSING); strings are compared verbatim against the repo file (BINDING_STRING_NOT_IN_REPO).

attribute.description: Attribute on the subject entity whose scope.dependencies holds the string.

repo_dependency.description: The dependency string exactly as it appears in the repository file.

binds_to.description: Node or cycle ids this string binds to. Empty means unbound so far.

status.description: PROPOSED: binding claimed, not yet compared. UNCHECKED: comparison not run. UNKNOWN: repo file unavailable to the checker. TRACED: string found verbatim in the named attribute's scope.dependencies.
